rca_unanticipated: Broad risk-off selling overwhelmed the neutral index scenario.
rca_overestimated: The forecast gave too much weight to a limited set of defensive signals.
rca_underestimated: Market breadth and foreign selling needed a larger penalty in the final score.
lessons: When foreign distribution and weak breadth align, do not keep an index call neutral without a strong counter-signal.
summary: JCI closed at 6,277.04 (-1.69%); the neutral pre-market forecast missed the magnitude of the sell-off.
